title: Jr. Associate - Product Information Management
description:
**The** **Opportunity:**
------------------------


Avantor is seeking a Jr. Associate for the Product Information Management team.

 **QUALIFICATIONS (Education/Training, Experience and Certifications)**

* Minimum of a graduate Degree in Life science or an equivalent subject.
* Practical Laboratory experience and good product knowledge is a plus

**KNOWLEDGE SKILLS AND ABILITIES (Those necessary to perform the job competently)**

* Excellent communication skills (verbal and written)
* Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy
* Demonstrated superior writing, copyediting, proofreading and research skills
* Ability to organize and prioritize multiple tasks simultaneously
* Familiarity of basic knowledge in the instrument and chemicals are needed
* Efficiency in a deadline\-driven environment with multiple concurrent assignments
* Proficiency with MS Office applications, Adobe Acrobat
* Adhere to company’s Policies, procedures, rules and guidelines
* Always uphold company’s culture and values

**MAJOR JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Complete training and get certified on process/processes within the stipulated timeframe.
* Adhere to the workflow instructions/standard operating procedure provided by the business.
* Complete all assigned tasks as per Service Level requirements specified by the business and meet/exceed key performance parameters
* Liaise with both internal and external customers and provide resolution with a customer centric approach.
* Primary responsibilities are writing engaging scientific and marketing content for print and digital communication channels
* Research in various sources or information like supplier and distributor catalogs (printed and electronic), the internet, internal and external sources (Category Managers, product information, supplier representatives, etc.), and communicate them in a clear and concise manner, using the appropriate voice for our customers.
* Contribute to content strategy planning.
* Work closely with the Leadership, Marketing and Sales teams to ensure that content objectives are met.
* Proof\-read the documents for more extensive language editing and flag them promptly with the designated point of contact.
* To write content which meet SEO guidelines to increase web traffic.

  



**Disclaimer:**  

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Avantor is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

**Why Avantor?**

**Dare to go further in your career.** Join our global team of 14,000\+ associates whose passion for discovery and determination to overcome challenges relentlessly advances life\-changing science.  

  

**The work we do changes people's lives for the better.** It brings new patient treatments and therapies to market, giving a cancer survivor the chance to walk his daughter down the aisle. It enables medical devices that help a little boy hear his mom's voice for the first time. Outcomes such as these create unlimited opportunities for you to contribute your talents, learn new skills and grow your career at Avantor.  

  

We are committed to helping you on this journey through our diverse, equitable and inclusive culture which includes learning experiences to support your career growth and success. At Avantor, dare to go further and see how the impact of your contributions set science in motion to create a better world. **Apply today!**

title: Product Owner - Intern
description:
**About the Company**

Smartail is an innovative artificial intelligence\-based company dedicated to revolutionizing the education industry. Our flagship product, DeepGrade, is a cutting\-edge AI software application that automates the grading of exam answer sheets in schools and colleges. By leveraging advanced technologies such as computer vision, deep learning, and natural language processing, DeepGrade excels in recognizing young adult handwriting and provides accurate grading for handwritten descriptive answers. It not only streamlines the grading process but also enhances learning, pedagogical decision\-making, assessment, and feedback for educational institutions. As a unique and pioneering product, DeepGrade sets a new standard in the education sector, transforming the way educators and students interact with assessment and feedback.

**About the Role**

We are a product\-based company looking for a driven and analytical product owner intern to join our growing product team. This is a hands\-on internship where you will work closely with cross\-functional teams—engineering, design, and business—to shape and deliver meaningful product experiences.

High performers will be considered for a full\-time product owner/product manager role upon successful completion of the 3\-month internship.

**Key Responsibilities**

▪ Develop a deep understanding of the business domain, target users, and competitive landscape

▪ Collaborate with stakeholders to define product vision, goals, and priorities

▪ Create and maintain a well\-structured product roadmap aligned with business objectives

▪ Write clear, detailed user stories with well\-defined acceptance criteria.

▪ Manage and prioritize the product backlog to ensure the team works on the highest\-value items.

▪ Track user stories from inception to closure, ensuring timely and quality delivery

▪ Facilitate sprint planning, backlog grooming, and review sessions with the engineering team

▪ Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and the development team

▪ Gather and incorporate user feedback to continuously improve product features.

▪ Monitor product metrics and report on KPIs to drive data\-informed decisions

**Qualifications \& Eligibility**

▪ MBA graduate (completed or final year) with specialization in product management, operations, or strategy\-referred

▪ Prior academic or project experience in product management or business analysis

▪ Familiarity with Agile / Scrum methodologies

▪ Exposure to tools like JIRA, Confluence, Trello, or similar

▪ Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate business needs into product requirements

▪ Excellent written and verbal communication skills

▪ Self\-starter with a proactive mindset and ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment

**Good to Have**

▪ Understanding of UX/UI principles and design thinking

▪ Exposure to SQL, analytics tools, or data dashboards

▪ Prior internship in a product\-based or SaaS company

▪ Ability to create wireframes using Figma or Miro

**What You Will Gain**

▪ Real\-world experience owning and driving a product in a live business environment

▪ Mentorship from experienced product and business leaders

▪ Hands\-on exposure to the full product development cycle\-ideation to release

▪ A strong product portfolio with tangible outcomes

▪ Performance\-based pathway to a full\-time role

**Internship Details**

Duration: 3 Months

Stipend: ₹10,000 per month

Preferred: MBA (Product Management / Strategy)

Post\-Internship: Full\-time conversion based on performance

This is a full on\-site role—you will be required to work from our office on all working days.

Pay: From ₹10,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Manager, Firmware Engineering
description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.


We are seeking an experienced **M2 Manager, Firmware Engineering** to lead firmware execution for Keyboard and Mouse New Product Introductions (NPIs).  



  

This role is responsible for managing a team of firmware engineers and driving end\-to\-end firmware delivery for new keyboard, mouse, and combo products—from concept validation through engineering builds, design verification, manufacturing ramp, and launch.  



  

The ideal candidate combines strong embedded firmware expertise with proven people leadership, cross\-functional program execution, and a deep understanding of consumer electronics development in high\-volume environments  



  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead firmware development for PWS keyboard and mouse NPI programs
* Manage and develop a team of firmware engineers
* Drive firmware execution across EVT, DVT, PVT, and production
* Partner cross\-functionally with Hardware, QA, Program management, EE and Mechanical Team, Suppliers and SOC Vendors
* Oversee firmware architecture, implementation, debugging, and release readiness
* Ensure robust wireless performance, low power consumption, device reliability, and manufacturability
* Support factory bring\-up, production test, and post\-ramp issue resolution
Drive continuous improvement in firmware development processes and team effectiveness  
* 

  

**Skills Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
* 8\+ years of embedded firmware experience
* 3\+ years of engineering management or technical team leadership
* Experience delivering consumer electronics products through NPI into mass production
* Strong proficiency in embedded C/C\+\+, MCU systems, wireless technologies, and debugging tools
* Ability to lead cross\-functional teams and execute in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience with keyboard, mouse, HID, BLE, USB, or wireless peripherals is strongly preferred
* Ability to communicate highly technical concepts to non\-technical individuals.
* Highly organized with strong multi\-project planning, management, and tracking skills.
* Experience with version control tools, such as Git.
* Expertise in using AI Tools and creating tools using AI
* Familiarity with Agile development, unit testing, and scripting.
* Experience in Bluetooth and bidirectional RF Human Interface Device (HID) firmware development.

Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. We help teams collaborate/learn from anywhere, without compromising on productivity or continuity so it should be no surprise that most of our jobs are open to work from home from most locations. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on\-premises. Within this structure, you may have teams or departments split between working remotely and working in\-house.
  

  

Logitech is an amazing place to work because it is full of authentic people who are inclusive by nature as well as by design. Being a global company, we value our diversity and celebrate all our differences. Don’t meet every single requirement? Not a problem. If you feel you are the right candidate for the opportunity, we strongly recommend that you apply. We want to meet you!  



  

We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits packages and working environments that are designed to be flexible and help you to care for yourself and your loved ones, now and in the future. We believe that good health means more than getting medical care when you need it. Logitech supports a culture that encourages individuals to achieve good physical, financial, emotional, intellectual and social wellbeing so we all can create, achieve and enjoy more and support our families. We can’t wait to tell you more about them being that there are too many to list here and they vary based on location.
  

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, age, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.
  

  

If you require an accommodation to complete any part of the application process, are limited in the ability, are unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact us toll free at \+1\-510\-713\-4866 for assistance and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

title: Product Manager
description:
Overview:

Product Manager to drive the AI product portfolio through the full lifecycle — from prioritised plan to build, release, launch and adoption. Working alongside the Practice Head (Product Owner), who owns product features, requirements, industry benchmarking, the business case and go\-to\-market engagement, the Product Manager holds the product roadmap and prioritisation, translating the Practice Head's features and requirements into a sequenced, deliverable plan. The role engages clients directly — through demonstrations and requirement\-gathering, and into product support once each product is live in the client environment — drawing on Expleo's specialist Cyber Security, Cloud, Data, DevOps and Dev / QA practices throughout.


Across delivery, the Product Manager ensures the Dev / QA team completes the solution design (high\- and low\-level design) ahead of build, coordinates the development, QA and DevOps teams through the build, and owns release and version governance across products and their underlying models. Security is embedded by design and owned end\-to\-end by the Cyber Security practice: the Product Manager gates security, compliance and responsible\-AI requirements into the definition of done and acts on each product's security assessment report before release
Responsibilities:
* **Roadmap \& Prioritisation**
* Own the AI portfolio roadmap and prioritisation, sequencing delivery and articulating trade\-offs and rationale transparently to stakeholders.
* Translate the product features and requirements owned by the Practice Head (Product Owner) into a prioritised, deliverable plan.
* Rationalise the existing roadmap toward the highest\-value outcomes across the portfolio.

**Delivery Coordination**

* Ensure the Dev / QA team completes the solution design (high\-level and low\-level design) ahead of build, with input from the Cloud, Data, Cyber Security and DevOps practices.
* Partner closely with the development, QA and DevOps teams and the Cyber Security, Cloud and Data practices throughout delivery, maintaining disciplined scope control against the agreed requirements.

**Security, Compliance \& Responsible AI**

* Ensure security, compliance and responsible\-AI requirements are captured, prioritised and gated as part of the definition of done — with all security owned by the Cyber Security practice, supported by the DevOps and Data practices.
* Obtain the security assessment report from the Cyber Security practice for each product, review the findings, and ensure they are prioritised and remediated before release.

**Release \& Version Governance**

* Establish a predictable release cadence and consistent versioning across the portfolio — covering both products and their underlying models — ensuring full traceability of what changed and when.

**Governance \& AI Management System (ISO/IEC 42001\)**

* Adhere to and enforce Expleo's ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management System) process for each product, working with the process team to embed it across the product lifecycle.
* Ensure every product complies with the ISO/IEC 42001 standard and maintains its certification, in line with Expleo's governance requirements.
* Support the internal ISO/IEC 42001 audit conducted for each Expleo product — providing product evidence, coordinating audit responses, and driving identified findings to closure.
* Support external certification and surveillance audits with the artefacts and evidence required to achieve and maintain certification.

**Production Roll\-out \& Adoption**

* Support the production roll\-out of each AI product — coordinating deployment readiness, go\-live and post\-go\-live stabilisation with the delivery, operations and Cloud practice teams, aligned to the go\-to\-market plan led by the Practice Head.
* Own post\-launch adoption and revenue KPIs, monitoring performance and initiating corrective action where required.

**Client Engagement \& Product Support**

* Participate in client demonstrations and steering discussions, understanding client needs and relaying them to the Practice Head (Product Owner) for requirement definition.
* Liaise with the development, QA and DevOps teams and the Cyber Security, Cloud and Data practices to translate the agreed requirements into delivery.
* Once the product is delivered into the client environment, initiate and coordinate ongoing product support.

**Portfolio Health \& Lifecycle Decisions**

* Review product health on a quarterly basis and provide data\-driven invest, maintain or retire recommendations to the Practice Head, including managed product sunset where appropriate.

**ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE**

* A minimum of 12 years' experience in product management roles for B2B digital products, including at least one product taken through a full lifecycle stage transition.
* Demonstrable experience with cloud delivery models and direct commercial engagement, including participation in customer steering forums.
* Proven command of release management and versioning discipline, consistently delivering predictable, well\-governed product releases.
* A strong appreciation of security, compliance and responsible\-AI considerations as product requirements, with experience collaborating with cyber security, DevOps, cloud and data functions.
* Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to drive decisions through well\-structured documentation.

**DESIRABLE QUALIFICATIONS**

* Hands\-on experience with GenAI, machine learning or agentic products.
* Familiarity with ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management System) or comparable AI governance and certification frameworks.
* A track record of establishing product\-management discipline within a maturing team or function.
* A relevant professional certification (e.g., CSPO, SAFe POPM, PMP).

**KEY COMPETENCIES \& BEHAVIOURS**

* Strategic thinking balanced with hands\-on execution.
* Sound commercial judgement and effective prioritisation under ambiguity.
* Ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* A security\- and quality\-conscious mindset.
* Clear, concise, document\-led communication.

title: Lead Product Manager
description:
**Shape Enterprise Construction Data Architecture as a Product Manager – Common Data Environment (CDE)**
========================================================================================================


Are you a systems\-and\-customer thinker who excels at turning complex data integration layers into seamless, intuitive user experiences? Trimble is seeking a technically fluent Senior Product Manager to own how enterprise customers bring their data into **Trimble Connect**—and how they experience, structure, and govern that data once it arrives. As construction data multiplies across global tools and project teams, you will play a central role in driving the platform that connects the right people to the right data at the right time.

**About Us:**
-------------


Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is an industrial technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. In support of Trimble's Connect and Scale strategy and the Trimble Connected Construction vision, Trimble Connect serves as the open collaboration backbone for millions of users worldwide. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com

 **Our Product Ecosystem:** Trimble Connect is our central Common Data Environment (CDE) and cloud collaboration platform. It breaks down data silos across the entire Architecture, Engineering, Construction, and Operations (AECO) lifecycle, enabling informed decision\-making and open project collaboration.

**What Makes This Role Great:**
-------------------------------


In this high\-impact position, you will own Connect's data\-experience and CDE data domain end\-to\-end. You will partner directly with senior engineering leaders who build deep technical layers, weighing architectural trade\-offs where product strategy and platform architecture intersect. You will have full ownership over building application\-layer AI capabilities—such as AI\-assisted metadata, automated classification, and smart import mapping—while acting as an industry thought leader representing Trimble across globally distributed customer networks.

**Key Exciting Responsibilities**
---------------------------------

* **Product Definition \& Strategic Roadmap:** Transform a fragmented set of data capabilities and integrations into a coherent, highly differentiated product narrative tied directly to Trimble Connect's global growth strategy.
* **AI\-Forward Data Experience:** Design and deploy modern application\-layer AI features within the data experience, including AI\-assisted metadata generation, automated file classification, and smart import mapping.
* **Technical \& Architectural Leadership:** Partner closely with senior engineering leaders on platform requirements, leveraging deep technical fluency to weigh architecture trade\-offs across data models, authorization frameworks, and APIs.
* **Customer Engagement \& Market Insights:** Conduct direct strategic discovery with key users and C\-level customer executives to uncover actionable operational insights and validate platform capabilities.
* **Product Evangelism \& Thought Leadership:** Represent Trimble Connect as an industry thought leader at major forums, elevating our market credibility across the global construction ecosystem.
* **Cross\-Functional Influence:** Lead and align cross\-functional, globally distributed teams, translating complex data analysis and business goals into clear, executable product milestones.

**Essential Skills \& Experience**
----------------------------------

* **Product Management Track Record:** 5\+ years of direct experience operating as a platform Product Manager with a referenceable history of delivering impactful B2B software products.
* **Technical \& Architectural Fluency:** High technical literacy with the ability to discuss complex system trade\-offs alongside senior engineers—including comfort with enterprise data models, APIs, SaaS mechanics, and tiered authorization protocols.
* **Systems \& Customer Thinking:** Exceptional ability to conceptualize complex software ecosystems and synthesize fragmented integrations into a unified, user\-friendly platform experience.
* **Stakeholder Influence \& Communication:** Outstanding communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills with a proven track record of influencing senior leadership and cross\-functional teams without direct authority.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline).

### **Bonus Points For:**

* **Construction Tech Domain Expertise:** Direct experience within construction technology or a closely adjacent enterprise B2B software domain.
* **CDE \& AEC Product Knowledge:** Deep familiarity with Common Data Environments (CDE), collaboration tools, or spatial/BIM data management products in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry.
* **AI Integration:** Hands\-on experience defining or launching AI/ML\-assisted features within enterprise SaaS platforms.

**Logistics:**
--------------

* **Department:** AECO Platform
* **Job Type:** Full\-Time

**Why You'll Love Working With Us**
-----------------------------------


At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real\-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.

* **You'll work on projects that truly matter:** Our purpose\-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide.
* **Collaborate with like\-minded people:** Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging.
* **Be an owner:** Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self\-authored," empowering proactive "doers."
* **Enjoy true flexibility:** We offer flexible work arrangements, which are a significant driver for employees joining and staying with us.

 **How to Apply:** Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.

**Join a Values\-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.**


At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

title: Product Owner III
description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting\-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency.
By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real\-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy. We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.
### **Role Overview:**



PDI Technologies is looking for a Product Owner to help drive our mobile product roadmap from vision to delivery. This individual will take roadmap initiatives and solution briefs and break them down into clear, well\-structured PRDs that our engineering teams can pick up and execute against — keeping delivery moving in a fast\-paced, iterative environment.



This role sits within our broader Mobile Platform and Framework effort — the underlying solution that lets customers bring a highly customizable, flexible branded app to market — with expected primary focus on Mobile Engagement Manager (MEM), a web\-based portal being built on top of the Mobile Platform that will let end customers modify, update, and change elements of their own mobile app themselves, backed by a full publishing engine. MEM is early in its build, so this is a chance to help shape a new product from the ground up alongside engineering and design. Exact scope of ownership across the Mobile Platform and MEM will be finalized as the team ramps up, and there is flexibility for this to evolve.



As a Product Owner, you are a critical member of an Agile development team, translating product strategy into high\-quality, high\-value features. You'll work closely with Agile engineering teams, Product Managers, customers, and business stakeholders to shape requirements for our consumer\-facing mobile experiences. Prior experience in Product Management, Product Owner, or Business Analyst roles for a consumer\-focused mobile app or platform/framework product is highly desired.



This role is expected to use AI tools and processes as a core part of how work gets done — accelerating requirements\-gathering, documentation, and story breakdown so the team can move faster without sacrificing quality.


### **Key Responsibilities:**


* **Stay aligned with and contribute to** the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for Mobile Engagement Manager (MEM), with visibility into the broader Mobile Platform/Framework

If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast\-forward your career at Comcast. **Job Summary**


This job is responsible for defining and guiding the introduction of new data\- and technology\-based products, coordinating cross\-functional efforts. It involves planning and developing innovative features for existing programs, ensuring alignment with market needs. The role is key to managing the product lifecycle from concept to launch.**Job Description**

title: Principal Technical Product Manager
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

Help build the enterprise AI runtime and agentic platform that will power AI solutions across Optum.

  

AI Factory Runtime and Agentic Platform Services provides a secure, scalable platform that enables engineering teams to deploy and operate AI workloads and agents across private cloud, public cloud, and hybrid environments.

  

As Principal Technical Product Manager \- AI Runtime, Agentic Platform \& Compute, you will own the product strategy for this critical layer of AI Factory. You will transform GPU compute, Kubernetes, model serving, inference, agent runtimes, agent orchestration, multi\-agent execution, lifecycle management, and observability into enterprise services that development teams can easily consume.

  

You will define the product vision, roadmap, service model, and investment priorities while partnering with Engineering, Compute, Cloud, Security, Governance, Risk, Compliance, and Architecture leaders to build a high\-performance enterprise AI platform.

  

This role owns the AI runtime, compute, and operational agent platform experience. It does not own underlying physical infrastructure, enterprise model approval and Responsible AI policy processes, or the business\-specific agents, AI applications, and solutions built by consuming teams.

  

AI can only scale across the enterprise when engineering teams have secure, reliable, and easy\-to\-consume runtime and agent platform capabilities beneath their solutions.

  

You will turn advanced GPU, Kubernetes, AI runtime, and agent execution technologies into standardized enterprise services that help teams move AI workloads and agents into production faster, while integrating with enterprise\-approved model access, security, and governance services.

  

This is an opportunity to shape a foundational AI platform serving one of the world's largest healthcare enterprises and influence how engineering teams securely deploy and operate AI workloads and agents at enterprise scale.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities for AI Factory Runtime and Agentic Platform Services across private cloud, public cloud, and hybrid environments
* Define clear product boundaries, ownership, and integration points across AI Factory, Compute, Cloud, Security, Governance, Architecture, enterprise AI enablement services, and consuming AI solution teams
* Productize GPU compute, Kubernetes/OpenShift, model serving, LLM inference, agent runtimes, agent orchestration, multi\-agent execution, agent lifecycle management, and platform APIs into standardized services engineering teams can easily consume
* Define the roadmap and service model for operational agent platform capabilities, including agent deployment, execution, orchestration, scaling, lifecycle management, observability, tool connectivity, and governance integration
* Create a leading developer experience, including self\-service onboarding, service tiers, APIs, SLOs/SLAs, documentation, consumption models, and platform automation
* Develop a deep understanding of AI workload, agent workload, and customer requirements and translate them into platform capabilities, architecture priorities, and measurable business outcomes
* Partner with engineering and architecture teams to evolve AI runtime and agent platform capabilities across private cloud, Azure, AWS, GCP, and hybrid environments while abstracting infrastructure complexity from consumers
* Partner with Security, Governance, Risk, and Compliance teams to incorporate security, privacy, Responsible AI, observability, and governance requirements into platform services without duplicating enterprise policy, model approval, or governance ownership
* Partner with Compute and Cloud Engineering to understand workload demand and improve GPU utilization, capacity efficiency, platform performance, reliability, and cost effectiveness
* Drive enterprise adoption and measure success through outcomes such as time\-to\-first\-workload, time\-to\-first\-agent, platform utilization, reliability, onboarding speed, adoption, and customer satisfaction
* Influence senior technology leaders and drive decisions across competing customer, engineering, architecture, security, operational, and investment priorities
* Technology Environment
	+ This role will influence a modern enterprise AI runtime and agentic platform incorporating technologies and practices such as:
	+ Kubernetes and Red Hat OpenShift
	+ NVIDIA GPU platforms
	+ GPU\-enabled container workloads
	+ AI model serving and inference
	+ Agent runtimes
	+ Agent orchestration and multi\-agent execution
	+ Agent lifecycle management
	+ Tool and API connectivity
	+ Public and private cloud
	+ APIs and automation
	+ GitOps
	+ Observability and telemetry
	+ Platform engineering
	+ Experience with every technology is not expected. We are looking for someone with strong platform fundamentals who can rapidly understand emerging AI and agentic technologies and translate them into enterprise products
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* 10\+ years of experience across technical product management, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, architecture, or related technology leadership roles, including significant product ownership or product leadership experience
* Experience owning, designing, or shaping an enterprise platform, developer platform, cloud service, Kubernetes platform, distributed compute platform, agent platform, or comparable technology product
* Experience defining product strategy, roadmaps, service models, SLOs/SLAs, adoption metrics, consumption models, and investment priorities
* Solid understanding of Kubernetes/container platforms, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, platform engineering, or GPU/AI compute architectures
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex infrastructure, runtime, and agent platform capabilities into simple, consumable platform products and developer experiences.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate complex platform strategies to executive audiences and influence senior engineering, architecture, security, product, and business leaders without direct authority
* Proven ability to build consensus and make trade\-offs across competing customer, engineering, architecture, security, operational, and business priorities

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, or a related discipline
* Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, GPU compute, model serving, LLM inference, agent runtimes, agentic platforms, agent orchestration frameworks, multi\-agent systems, or AI runtime platforms
* Experience with Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, NVIDIA GPU technologies, or other large\-scale container and accelerated\-compute environments
* Experience with enterprise AI or cloud AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Databricks, or similar technologies
* Experience with agent deployment, execution, orchestration, lifecycle management, observability, or tool connectivity patterns
* Experience building platforms spanning private cloud, public cloud, and hybrid environments
* Experience with developer self\-service, platform engineering, observability, capacity management, FinOps, or AI governance integration
* Experience delivering technology platforms within large\-scale or highly regulated enterprises

 **The Candidate We're Looking For**

* The solid candidate will think of infrastructure, runtime, and agent platform capabilities as products rather than simply technologies.
* You should be comfortable moving between AI workloads, agent workloads, GPU compute, Kubernetes, APIs, developer experience, platform economics, and executive strategy without needing to be the deepest engineer in every technology.
* You enjoy taking complex infrastructure and agent platform capabilities and making them simple for developers to consume. You can make decisions while technology and customer requirements are changing rapidly, and influence a large organization through technical credibility, product thinking, and a clear vision for where the platform needs to go.

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*
